pattern.title: From Capacity to Quality: A New Constraint for AI Infrastructure
pattern.before: AI power demand was treated as a steady, growing total to be met with additional generation and grid connections.
pattern.shift: Dossier signal identifies that AI workloads cause rapid, volatile power swings that physically damage data center equipment and destabilize local grids.
pattern.now: The binding constraint is no longer just total megawatts but the ability to absorb and mitigate AI’s volatile load profiles.
pattern.conclusion: AI infrastructure planning must incorporate power-quality and reliability metrics, potentially limiting viable locations and increasing costs.

insight.title: Power Volatility, Not Just Volume, Could Gate AI Expansion
insight.formula: AI growth + unmanaged power swings = equipment damage + grid instability → new reliability barrier
